title: Sum of Matrix After Queries
description:
You are given an integer `n` representing an `n x n` 0-indexed matrix initially filled with all `0`s, and a 2D array `queries` where each `queries[i] = [type, index, val]`:
- If `type == 0`, set every cell in row `index` to `val`, overwriting any previous values.
- If `type == 1`, set every cell in column `index` to `val`, overwriting any previous values.

Return the **sum** of all integers in the matrix after all queries have been applied in order.
constraints: type is 0 or 1, 0 <= index < n, 0 <= val <= 10^5
hints: Later assignments overwrite earlier ones, so iterate through queries in reverse order (from last to first).

Keep sets (or boolean arrays) of already-finalized rows and columns along with remaining unfinalized counts remRows and remCols: the first time you see a row from the end, it contributes val * remCols to the total sum.

examples.explanation: Processing backwards: col 0 gets 4 (3 cells -> 12), row 2 gets 3 (2 remaining cells -> 6), col 2 gets 2 (2 remaining cells -> 4), row 0 gets 1 (1 remaining cell -> 1), totaling 23.
After applying all five queries in order, the final 3x3 matrix is [[1,4,1],[1,2,1],[1,3,1]], which sums to 17.
On a 1x1 matrix, the last query sets the only cell to 7.
